entities.name: Library Management System
entities.description: Provides public and academic libraries with catalogue management, circulation control, and self-service portals, enforcing strict EU-only data residency and high-performance search requirements.

entities.name: Library Patrons
entities.description: Students and public citizens who use the self-service portals to access catalogue management and digital content.

entities.name: Circulation Staff and Library Administrators
entities.description: Staff and administrators responsible for managing library operations, circulation control, and system administration.

entities.name: Identity Provider / SSO
entities.description: External system supporting SAML/Shibboleth and local accounts for federated authentication.

entities.name: Digital Content Providers
entities.description: External vendor systems for e-books and audiobooks.

entities.name: Notification Gateway
entities.description: External SMS/Email provider for dispatching notifications.

entities.name: Observability & Logging Platform
entities.description: Prometheus/Grafana platform for monitoring and logging.

interfaces.description: Accesses catalogue management, circulation control, and self-service portals
Manages library operations and system administration
Integrates with vendor systems for e-books and audiobooks

naming_conventions: Users and actors are named using plural descriptive titles such as 'Library Patrons' or 'Circulation Staff and Library Administrators'
External systems are named based on their primary function and industry standard terminology
